infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Atleato uses your location during runs to track the route and award you the grid cells you pass through in the Territory game.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Atleato uses your camera to analyze your exercise form in real time and to capture physique progress photos. Photos are encrypted on your device before upload.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required by the camera framework but is not used by Atleato.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Atleato accesses your photo library so you can select physique progress photos. Photos are encrypted on your device before upload — we never see the originals.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Atleato may save processed images to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Atleato does not access Apple Health data.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Atleato does not write to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSHealthClinicalHealthRecordsShareUsageD: Atleato does not access clinical health records.
